name: Four Seasons Hotel Seattle
positioning: Downtown Seattle hotel across from the Seattle Art Museum and one block from Pike Place Market, with a heated infinity-edged pool on an outdoor terrace
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base across from the Seattle Art Museum and a block from Pike Place Market
Families (Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel as family friendly)

facts.text: The hotel has 147 rooms in total.
The hotel is across the street from the Seattle Art Museum.
The hotel is one block from Pike Place Market.
The hotel comprises floors 1 through 10 of a 21-storey building.
Goldfinch Tavern is the hotel's upscale, waterfront restaurant.
Ethan Stowell is the consulting chef at Goldfinch Tavern.
The hotel's complimentary house car is available for destinations within a one-mile radius.
The hotel's spa was renovated in 2026.
Condé Nast Traveler's review lists the hotel as family friendly: "Extremely!"

highlights.text: Coffee Concierge delivers a complimentary cup of brew directly to your room each morning.
The outdoor terrace overlooking Elliott Bay and Olympic Mountains features a heated infinity-edged pool.
Every guest room and suite has deep soaking tubs and separate rain showers.
Goldfinch Tavern serves a Sunday buffet brunch.
The hotel displays original works by Pacific Northwest School artists.

considerations.text: Overnight valet parking costs USD 75 per night.
The garage has vehicle clearance restrictions.
The hotel asks guests to contact it about the availability of the pool.
Guests must be ages 16 or over to access the spa facilities.
WhataHotel notes the urban downtown setting may lack a tranquil resort atmosphere.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
